## CARDIAC DISEASE ASSOCIATED WITH LYME DISEASE
Carditis is a rare manifestation of Lyme Disease and typically occurs within one
to two months after onset of infection.
## Consult Infectious Diseases and Cardiology in all cases
## Duration of therapy
Treat for 14 to 21 days. Cardiology consult recommended.
## Treatment of first degree or second-degree heart block
Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]
For pregnant patients or patients with doxycycline allergy
Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h ($) [R]
## Treatment of third-degree heart block or other manifestation
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M]

## Treatment of third-degree heart block or other manifestation

## Treatment of first degree or second-degree heart block
